canonical_name: The Fred C. Trump December 16, 1976 Trust

aliases.name: The Fred C. Trump December 16, 1976 Trust- F/B/O Donald J. Trump
aliases.notes: Section header on Part 6 p020 of cp_filing_0003. Discloses one holding: a JP Morgan Chase Savings Account at $1,000,001 - $5,000,000 (Interest $1,001 - $2,500). Canonical drops the 'F/B/O Donald J. Trump' beneficiary suffix as that's annotation, not part of the trust's legal name.

notes: Trust established December 16, 1976 by Fred C. Trump (Donald J. Trump's father) for the benefit of Donald J. Trump. Distinct from The Donald J. Trump Revocable Trust (cp_entity_0003), which is Donald's self-settled grantor trust dated April 7, 2014. The 1976 Trust is a third-party-settled (testamentary or inter vivos) trust where Donald is the named beneficiary. Discloses a single JP Morgan Chase Savings Account holding on cp_filing_0003 Part 6. Registered in Fork G per amendment Decision D.3 (Path A: formally named trust). Beneficial-interest edge from Trump in cp_rel_0359.
